kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعاقد (form VI)
# نَتَعَاقَدُ (nataʕāqadu) /na.ta.ʕaː.qa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاقَدَ (taʕāqada)
# نَتَعَاقَدَ (nataʕāqada) /na.ta.ʕaː.qa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاقَدَ (taʕāqada)
# نَتَعَاقَدْ (nataʕāqad) /na.ta.ʕaː.qad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاقَدَ (taʕāqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
